reddit.title: Calculator's updated for the Nov 23 hotfix
reddit.body:
Nov 23 hotfixes are in. Class stuff only:

- **Priest** - Dark Inspiration now gives the right Spirit when Mind Flay triggers it. Dwarf priests can use Chastise in Shadowform.
- **Warlock** - Intensity works on Incinerate now.
- **Warrior** - you can't use Mortal Strike anymore without actually having the talent.
- **Druid** - Feralheart 4pc gives the 4 energy/sec it's supposed to.
- **Everyone** - world buffs don't drop when you change zones anymore (raids still clear them). Fengus' Ferocity and DMF buffs were giving double, that's fixed.

Winners: Shadow Priest (Dark Inspiration), Destro Warlock (Intensity), everyone with world buffs.
Losers: nobody, no real nerfs this time. The rest was bug fixes.

None of the builds needed changing this time. Every hotfix so far is listed here: https://talentsmith.app/changes.html

caption: Nov 23 hotfix: shadow priests and destro locks got fixes, world buffs now survive zoning #wowforever #worldofwarcraft
